nba.rules: Both venues resolve on the game's winner, overtime included. No ties. A game not played as scheduled can resolve differently: Polymarket resolves 50-50 if it isn't played by its resolution date; check Kalshi's rule for postponements.

nhl.rules: Both venues resolve on the game's winner, overtime and shootout included. No ties. Postponements can resolve differently on each venue.

mlb.rules: Both venues resolve on the game's winner, extra innings included. Suspended or postponed games can resolve differently on each venue.

nfl.rules: Enabled for paper benchmarking: on a tie each Kalshi team market resolves No while Polymarket's two-way moneyline may resolve 50-50, so a basket can lose. Trades record evidence.kalshi_tie_market.
